end.summary: Practised representing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised using a bundle for ten and separate sticks for the ones, and gave some correct representations such as “one bundle and three sticks” for 13. They also practised number sequences after fifteen and identified the tens digit as the left digit. There was a mix-up about whether a bundle counts as one object or ten when finding the total; this was not confirmed corrected by the end. At home, build numbers 11–20 with one group of 10 objects and loose ones, then ask, “How many altogether?”
